title: Lakehouse: tier status (16 nodes across MinIO + Iceberg + Spark + ZK)
description: Runs `nexus status lakehouse`. One table over the 16 nodes — 4 MinIO EC nodes, 2 Nessie REST catalog instances, the iceberg-pg pair (VIP .151 holder labelled PRIMARY), the 2 ZK-elected Spark masters (the ALIVE leader labelled), 3 Spark workers, and the 3-node ZooKeeper ensemble.

observe.what: 16-row table; one Spark master labelled ALIVE leader; iceberg-pg VIP .151 holder labelled PRIMARY; all alive; the ALIVE master named on the leader: line
JSON ClusterStatus: 16 members, leader = the ALIVE spark master, Shards null

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.GetStatusAsync classifies all 16 nodes by name-prefix, resolves the iceberg-pg VRRP VIP holder and the ZK-elected ALIVE Spark master dynamically, and rolls them into one table.
